title: CC DataSource
description: A named set of resource paths and internal data paths within one DataStore. Field names are taken verbatim from the json struct tags in USACE/cc-go-sdk datastore.go (DataSource), which is the de facto wire contract all four SDKs must match. Keys are frozen by standards.md STD-WIRE-005; do not re-case them.

name.description: Identifier used by SDK lookups (GetInputDataSource / GetOutputDataSource). May contain {ENV::} or {ATTR::} substitution tokens.

id.description: Optional stable identifier. Pointer in Go, so absent and null are both representable and MUST be treated as equivalent.

paths.description: Map of path key (e.g. "default") to resource path. A DataSource may legitimately have no paths when it addresses internal data only (data_paths), so this is not required.

data_paths.description: Map of data key to a path internal to the resource: DSS part paths, HDF table paths, raster subdatasets. Distinct from paths, which locate the resource itself.
data_paths.x-cc-note: The Confluence payload example omits data_paths entirely. It is load-bearing for DSS/HDF plugins and MUST NOT be dropped by an SDK.

store_name.description: Name of the DataStore holding this source. Looked up by IOManager.GetStore, which searches the local scope then the parent payload. Required in practice: a DataSource without it cannot be read or written.
store_name.x-cc-note: Not required by the schema because Go marks it omitempty and making it required would reject already-registered payloads (STD-WIRE-002). SDKs SHOULD emit a validation warning when it is absent rather than an error.
